findings.title: Lossy u128->f64 DiagramId in every captured diagram JSON, undisclosed
findings.evidence: identical_observation::diagram and identical_final_observation::record parse d.to_json() into serde_json::Value, which cannot hold u128: all 416 ledger json.id values (raw-diagrams, staged-pair/-final, group-entry, collapse-entry, into-representative, representative-output, final-diagrams) and all 90 FinalFrame output.json.id are f64 approximations (e.g. D00 exact 240124890194191393657841613544593172197 -> 2.401248901941914e+38). Exact ids survive only as the ledger's separate hex `id` and in the census; FinalFrame records carry no exact id, and id equality in the retained FinalFrame->built deltas is only ~53-bit.
findings.required_change: Disclose in record/receipt; add an additive exact-id binding (ledger hex ids; FinalFrame line -> exact hex id via the validated association); state that consumers must never use json.id. No recapture needed.

findings.title: 'Only its read-only hooks' overstates observer non-interference
findings.evidence: When OBS_* is set: every finalize() in the process (incl. Auto and NamingNone builds) reads the gate env/file; begin() writes the gate file with unwrap; serialization adds expect/unwrap panic paths absent from pristine; uncook(ReversibleEncoding)->dimension_payload->Atom::parse can intern symbols in Symbolica's process-global table (not exercised here: 0 cooked symbols, decoded==raw for all captured tensors); feynkit_generator gains a serde_json dependency. Only the byte-join of this row/pool1 shows no observable effect.
findings.required_change: Replace with an explicit side-effect and scope-limited non-interference statement.

findings.title: Producer validator coverage overstated for several record/receipt claims
findings.evidence: Retained validate.py VALIDATES private copies with a dropped (renumbered) comparison-decision, prepare-zero zero=true, group-cancellation cancelled=true, merge ratio set to null, a non-unit FinalFrame INPUT tensor, or a relabelled qualification code. It checks the stage domain only as a set and only OUTPUT unit tensors, yet record.typ attributes 'stage coverage' and the phase claim to it. The facts themselves are TRUE (verified by this review's analyzer on retained and fresh captures).
findings.required_change: Extend validate.py or cite an executable guard (e.g. this review's analyze-capture.mjs) for these claims; mark code-label binding reviewer-manual.

findings.title: serde_json extern injected into the private feynkit_generator not disclosed in record/receipt
findings.evidence: Not a [dependencies] entry (dev-dependency only); attempt-2 failed with 13 unresolved serde_json errors; compile.py adds the root unit's serde_json. Same qualified artifact as the pristine test's serde_json (layer member 8782c9ef; identical v0 disambiguator in both ELFs).

findings.evidence: dep-info env-dep shows only CARGO_CRATE_NAME (correct) consumed, so no compiled effect.
findings.required_change: Note; fix in any future build.

findings.title: 'pool 1' needs qualification
findings.evidence: Run::threads(1) governs generation; harness Census::of uses a static 8-thread rayon pool and summary() the global pool. Events come only from the generation path and harness main thread; ledger writes are mutex-serialized with contiguous sequence.
